newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgians in favour of Euro - survey.
newsitem.headline: Belgians in favour of Euro - survey.

text.p: Belgians are overwhelmingly in favour of a single European currency, the Euro, but many also expect a rocky ride ahead of its introduction, a survey said on Wednesday.
A survey of 1,600 readers of the Cash! weekly financial newspaper and Swingtrend investment letter showed 80 percent welcomed the Euro, which is due to be launched in 1999.
But nearly four in 10 anticipated turbulent times in the run-up to 1999 which might spark adjustments to the original criteria laid out by the Maastricht Treaty.
More than 91 percent believed Belgium would join the single currency from the onset.
Two thirds were convinced the Euro would be a strong currency, comparable with the German mark or Dutch guilder.
The same proportion slammed banks for insufficiently informing clients about the new currency.
